sections.title: State Laws and Rules of the Road
State Laws and Rules of the Road

objectives.title: License classes and required documents carried while driving
objectives.description: Differentiate Class D from other classes; identify license, registration and insurance requirements.

objectives.title: Application documentation
objectives.description: Locate citizenship/identity/address requirements and the appropriate SCDMV checklist.

objectives.title: Beginner’s permit
objectives.description: Apply age, tests, supervision and age-dependent holding periods.

objectives.title: First-time licensing
objectives.description: Distinguish permit from first-license requirements, practice hours, driver education and school certification.

objectives.title: Graduated licensing
objectives.description: Apply conditional/special restricted license restrictions, exceptions and waiver boundaries.

objectives.title: Required tests
objectives.description: Identify test requirements, permitted preparation, vehicle readiness and skills-test retry intervals.

objectives.title: Out-of-state and international drivers
objectives.description: Distinguish visitors from residents and locate transfer and reciprocity guidance.

objectives.title: Renewal
objectives.description: Identify vision/renewal requirements and expired-license restrictions.

objectives.title: Points and loss of privileges
objectives.description: Explain point accumulation, age/license distinctions, suspensions and limits of point reduction.

objectives.title: Reinstatement and restricted licenses
objectives.description: Locate reinstatement guidance and distinguish restricted/temporary privileges from unrestricted driving.

objectives.title: Selective Service
objectives.description: Identify the application requirement and where it is described.

objectives.title: Organ donation
objectives.description: Explain donor registration and the stated under-18 guardian role.

objectives.title: Littering
objectives.description: Recognize litter, including cigarette butts, and lawful disposal.

objectives.title: Golf carts
objectives.description: Apply the manual’s age, license, permit, daylight, distance and roadway restrictions.

objectives.title: Other vehicle manuals
objectives.description: Locate separate commercial, large vehicle and motorcycle/moped guidance.

objectives.title: Vision
objectives.description: Apply corrective-lens restrictions and identify vision-screening guidance.

objectives.title: Fatigue
objectives.description: Recognize fatigue and choose rest and trip-planning responses.

objectives.title: Distractions and Hands-Free Act
objectives.description: Distinguish distraction risks from stated device prohibitions and penalties.

objectives.title: Aggressive driving
objectives.description: Recognize dangerous behaviors and choose patient responses.

objectives.title: Alcohol and drugs
objectives.description: Explain impairment, under-21 consequences, implied consent and medication interactions.

objectives.title: Emotions
objectives.description: Choose alternatives to driving while emotionally overwhelmed.

objectives.title: Older drivers
objectives.description: Recognize changes that warrant adjusting driving or professional evaluation.

objectives.title: Vehicle inspection
objectives.description: Check cold tire pressure against the door label and recognize inadequate tread.

objectives.title: Seat and mirrors
objectives.description: Adjust seating, head restraints and mirrors before moving; understand blind spots.

objectives.title: Safety belts
objectives.description: Apply belt fit and primary-enforcement guidance.

objectives.title: Air bags
objectives.description: Explain why air bags supplement rather than replace belts.

objectives.title: Child passenger safety
objectives.description: Choose restraints using the full age/size/fit conditions in the two-page table.

objectives.title: Secure loads
objectives.description: Identify load security measures and check for shifting or falling cargo.

objectives.title: ADAS
objectives.description: Recognize assistance limits and retain responsibility for observation and control.

objectives.title: Starting
objectives.description: Prepare brake/gear position and check dashboard indicators after starting.

objectives.title: Moving
objectives.description: Check the path and blind spots, signal and accelerate smoothly.

objectives.title: Stopping
objectives.description: Check rear traffic and use steady braking for a normal stop.

objectives.title: Steering grip
objectives.description: Use an outside-rim grip and appropriate two-hand positioning.

objectives.title: Hand-to-hand steering
objectives.description: Recognize push/pull use and benefits without relying on ambiguous clock-range wording.

objectives.title: Hand-over-hand steering
objectives.description: Recognize low-speed turning and parking use.

objectives.title: One-hand exceptions
objectives.description: Keep control during a temporary reach or backing; distinguish exceptions from routine driving.

objectives.title: Before reversing
objectives.description: Inspect behind the vehicle and hold the brake when shifting to reverse.

objectives.title: Backing visibility
objectives.description: Look directly rearward and use mirrors/camera as supporting checks until stopped.

objectives.title: Backing control
objectives.description: Back slowly; steer for the rear’s intended path and check front/sides when turning.

objectives.title: Yielding
objectives.description: Apply arrival order, simultaneous-arrival, left-turn, driveway and ramp yielding.

objectives.title: Traffic controls
objectives.description: Recognize signals, signs, markings and personnel as controls.

objectives.title: Signals
objectives.description: Distinguish steady/flashing lights and the conditions for a right turn on red.

objectives.title: Warning signs
objectives.description: Identify pictured hazards from shapes and symbols.

objectives.title: Railroad crossings
objectives.description: Interpret warnings, multiple-track indicators and crossing precautions.

objectives.title: Work-zone controls
objectives.description: Follow temporary signals, flaggers, signs and barriers.

objectives.title: Regulatory signs
objectives.description: Interpret prohibitions, lane use, speed, stop, yield and one-way signs.

objectives.title: Guide/route signs
objectives.description: Distinguish guide, route, secondary-route and evacuation signs.

objectives.title: Yellow markings
objectives.description: Use line patterns to identify opposing directions and passing permissions.

objectives.title: White markings and lane controls
objectives.description: Interpret same-direction lanes, shared left-turn lanes and reversible controls.

objectives.title: Crosswalks and stop lines
objectives.description: Choose the stopping position and yield at marked or unmarked crossings.

objectives.title: Turns
objectives.description: Choose lanes, yield and maintain position through single/multiple-lane turns.

objectives.title: Turnabouts
objectives.description: Distinguish two-/three-point maneuvers and choose appropriate situations.

objectives.title: Intersections
objectives.description: Search before entering; recognize DDI and RCUT layouts.

objectives.title: Roundabouts
objectives.description: Yield to circulating traffic, travel counterclockwise and signal exits.

objectives.title: School buses
objectives.description: Apply stop/resume rules and roadway/loading-zone exceptions.

objectives.title: Parking
objectives.description: Apply legal positioning and angle, perpendicular, parallel and hill-parking procedures.

objectives.title: Lane changes
objectives.description: Check mirrors and blind spots, signal and enter a safe gap.

objectives.title: Highway entry
objectives.description: Use the acceleration lane, match traffic and yield when merging.

objectives.title: Roadway exit
objectives.description: Plan the exit and slow in the deceleration lane.

objectives.title: Passing
objectives.description: Choose safe/legal passing, return clearance and behavior when passed.

objectives.title: Zipper merge
objectives.description: Distinguish backed-up traffic from free-flowing highway conditions.

objectives.title: Visual search
objectives.description: Scan ahead/sides/rear and adjust position to preserve visibility.

objectives.title: Speed management
objectives.description: Adjust before curves and for wet/icy roads; avoid flooded roads.

objectives.title: Stopping distance
objectives.description: Distinguish perception, reaction and braking distance and their conditions.

objectives.title: Space management
objectives.description: Use a four-second minimum and increase space when conditions require.

objectives.title: Communication
objectives.description: Choose headlights/horn appropriately and signal movements in advance.

objectives.title: Collision avoidance and braking
objectives.description: Distinguish emergency options and maintain ABS pressure rather than pumping.

objectives.title: Skids and drop-offs
objectives.description: Choose controlled steering and gradual recovery for the stated scenario.

objectives.title: Brake failure
objectives.description: Recognize the manual’s response; hold engine-off sequencing for safety review.

objectives.title: Tire blowout
objectives.description: Maintain direction, slow gradually and leave the road safely.

objectives.title: Power failure
objectives.description: Maintain control with steady braking and seek a safe stopping location.

objectives.title: Stuck accelerator
objectives.description: Identify the repair-before-driving requirement after a stuck-accelerator incident; emergency recovery sequence excluded.

objectives.title: Breakdown
objectives.description: Move off the road when possible, warn others and seek help.

objectives.title: Emergency contacts
objectives.description: Locate the SCDMV emergency-contact record service.

objectives.title: Pedestrians
objectives.description: Yield appropriately, protect visually impaired pedestrians and watch school/residential areas.

objectives.title: Bicyclists
objectives.description: Respect rights, pass with space and recognize signals, lane conflicts and dooring risks.

objectives.title: Motorcyclists
objectives.description: Allow full lanes and space; avoid assuming a flashing signal guarantees a turn.

objectives.title: Commercial vehicles
objectives.description: Avoid no-zones, leave stopping/turning space and pass with adequate clearance.

objectives.title: Emergency vehicles
objectives.description: Yield and pull aside without blocking routes.

objectives.title: Traffic stops
objectives.description: Stop safely, keep hands visible and follow instructions before reaching for documents.

objectives.title: Move-over law
objectives.description: Change lanes away when safe; otherwise slow and proceed cautiously.

objectives.title: Slow-moving vehicles
objectives.description: Recognize the triangle and pass farm/animal-drawn traffic cautiously.

objectives.title: Night driving
objectives.description: Choose beams and following distance for traffic, weather and visibility.

objectives.title: Work zones
objectives.description: Reduce speed, increase space and obey controls even without visible workers.

objectives.title: Rural roads
objectives.description: Adjust for traction, narrow roads/bridges, limited views and uncontrolled intersections.

objectives.title: Winter driving
objectives.description: Use gentle control, allow extra space and respond to ice or being stuck.

objectives.title: Trailer hookup
objectives.description: Check coupler, safety chains, lights and visibility.

objectives.title: Trailer loading
objectives.description: Understand front-heavy loading, securing cargo and sway response.

objectives.title: Trailer operation
objectives.description: Compensate in speed, space, turning, backing and repeated inspections.

objectives.title: Official practice resource
objectives.description: Identify the manual’s practice-app reference.

objectives.title: Sample knowledge questions
objectives.description: Use the ten samples to inform topic/style review, not to duplicate course completion.
